challenge_rule: Challenge A without changing source edition or using INT-family expectations.

challenges.source_reaudit_result: CRP cluster assignments are source-defined latent representations; no extra executive follows.
Planning is explicitly the source mechanism binding reward and mapping components into a policy.
The model-evidence meta-agent is explicitly proposed by the source as an extension and therefore, if represented, is source-defined coordination rather than reconstruction-added state.

challenges.objection: task context mistaken for control state
challenges.source_reaudit_result: Context is an observed/partially observed task/world variable constraining task statistics, not a newly inferred generic controller.
Independent/joint CRP assignments organize learned task statistics; the separate source meta-agent is the only model-selection mechanism in the extension.

challenges.objection: outcome metrics mistaken for cognitive state
challenges.source_reaudit_result: simulation performance, information gain and model evidence analyses are separated from persistent agent state except where the source explicitly uses evidence in the meta-agent.
Source says independent vs joint vs mixture remains open.
Unknown-transition S1 bytes were not frozen and remain noncanonical.
